name: Fort George, Grenada
scope: Standing masonry fort above the Carenage with its central parade, surviving barrack ranges, ramparts and lower approach works.
era: Surviving historic masonry envelope of Fort George during the current restoration period.

originalReview.notes: Exact original plate with printed de Caylus attribution and London Magazine publication. The detailed central figure shows the sloped curtain and bastion alignment, inner parade, barrack line, northern court, and seaward spurs.

review.method: Exactly matched public-domain originals, native building footprint and published architectural dimensions.
review.notes: Started with the Qualla gallery. Its otherwise public-domain images centre on a modern plaque and a mural, so the original December 1762 published survey plate establishes the walls and parade.
